rules:
The first line of the input contains a single integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 1000) — the total likes to the published photoes.

The second line contains n positive integers a1, a2, ..., an (1 ≤ ai ≤ 1 000 000), where ai is the identifier of the photo which got the i-th like. Unique result under retained statement; 727A inverse operations have disjoint parity and determine one path. Independent audit required.
